model_message.content:
I have both ends' OSPF area from valid running configs:
- r1 eth1: `ip ospf area 0.0.0.1` (E006)
- r2 eth1: `ip ospf area 0.0.0.0` (E008)

This is a confirmed Area mismatch, which explains the empty neighbor tables on both sides (E004, E005). Both interfaces are up (no admin shutdown), and neither has passive on eth1 (passive only on lo).

This is sufficient to classify as ospf_area_mismatch. I don't need to exhaustively check routes/pings since the root cause is directly confirmed by the area configuration on both ends.
